svg.title: Chapter 3 — HAMZA
svg.desc: Manga chapter title page: CHAPTER 3, HAMZA, THE STUDENT WHO SHIPS, with focus lines and menacing sound effects. The vertical title reads CODE BY HAAMZA in katakana. Speech bubbles: I don't leave projects half-finished… I just start too many of them. The page opens by zooming through the screen of a PSP.
